args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity):
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Fixed in
2.9.4 per the advisory.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to fix CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).
- Per the advisory, affected versions are <2.9.4 (and 3.0.x); 2.9.4 is the fixed release, so we stay on the 2.x line.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**.

## Review
- Requesting review from @alex (code owner approval required to merge into main).
